bookorbitAnnouncement.title: BookOrbit is the official successor to BookLore
bookorbitAnnouncement.description: BookOrbit takes BookLore far beyond library management: one home for ebooks, PDFs, comics, and audiobooks, with polished readers, cross-device progress and annotation sync, discovery and request automation, and deep reading insights. A native, offline-capable iOS app with Apple Watch audiobook playback is in active development.
bookorbitAnnouncement.migration: BookLore will remain available in maintenance mode for occasional maintenance, bug fixes, and security updates, with a guided migration path when you are ready.
